title: Smoked Salmon Kedgeree
summary: A classic British kedgeree with gently curried rice, flaked smoked salmon and softly cooked eggs. It’s savoury, fragrant and comforting, ideal for a hearty breakfast or brunch.
steps: Rinse the rice, then put it in a saucepan with the water and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce to low, and cook until tender and the water is absorbed, about 12 to 15 minutes. Set aside and fluff with a fork.
While the rice cooks, place the eggs in a small pan of cold water, bring to a simmer, and cook for 7 minutes for softly set yolks. Drain, cool briefly, peel, and cut into halves.
Heat the butter and olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until soft and translucent.
Stir in the curry powder and mustard and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the milk and cook for 1 minute, stirring, to make a lightly creamy curried base.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and toss until evenly coated and hot throughout. Season with salt and black pepper.
Gently fold in the smoked salmon and lemon juice, then scatter over the parsley. Take the pan off the heat so the salmon stays tender.
Serve the kedgeree in bowls with the halved eggs on top.
